export interface PlacedObject {
    kind: string;
    id: string;
    project_id: string | null;
}

export type PlacementAccess = "private" | "home" | "project";

export interface PlacementAssociation {
    key: string | null;
    type: PlacementAssociationType;
    label: string;
    target: {
        kind: "project";
        project_id: string;
        title: string;
    } | {
        kind: "goal";
        project_id: string | null;
        goal_id: string;
        title: string;
    } | {
        kind: "object";
        object: PlacedObject;
        title: string;
        state: PlacementObjectState;
        location: PlacementLocation | null;
    };
    since: string | null;
    removable: boolean;
}

export type PlacementAssociationType = "used_in" | "goal" | "derived_from" | "derived_into" | "copied_from" | "copied_into";

export interface PlacementConvertRequest {
    source: PlacedObject;
    to: PlacementConvertTarget;
    to_project_id: string;
    request_id: string;
    payload?: {
        title: string;
        body: string;
    };
}

export interface PlacementConvertResponse {
    object: PlacedObject;
    title: string;
    location: PlacementLocation;
    open: PlacementOpen | null;
}

export type PlacementConvertTarget = {
    station: string;
} | {
    goal: true;
};

export interface PlacementCreateRequest {
    station: string;
    project_id: string;
    title?: string;
    goal_id?: string | null;
    request_id: string;
}

export interface PlacementDescription {
    state: PlacementObjectState;
    reason: string | null;
    object: PlacedObject;
    title: string;
    plugin: {
        plugin_id: string;
        title: string;
    } | null;
    location: PlacementLocation | null;
    moved_from: PlacementLocation | null;
    associations: PlacementAssociation[];
    can: {
        move: boolean;
        copy: boolean;
        use_in_project: boolean;
    };
    open: PlacementOpen | null;
}

export interface PlacementGoalView {
    goal_id: string;
    title: string;
}

export interface PlacementLocation {
    kind: "personal" | "project";
    project_id: string | null;
    title: string;
    access: PlacementAccess;
    access_label: string;
}

export interface PlacementMoveResponse {
    object: PlacedObject;
    location: PlacementLocation;
    open: PlacementOpen | null;
}

export type PlacementObjectState = "ok" | "missing" | "unavailable";

export interface PlacementOpen {
    project_id: string | null;
    surface: string;
    id: string;
}

export interface PlacementRelatedItem {
    key: string;
    object: PlacedObject;
    title: string;
    state: PlacementObjectState;
    reason: string | null;
    location: PlacementLocation | null;
    plugin: {
        plugin_id: string;
        title: string;
    } | null;
    since: string;
    open: PlacementOpen | null;
}

export interface PlacementSpaceView {
    project_id: string;
    title: string;
    kind: "personal" | "project";
}

export type PlacementSubject = ActionSubject;

export declare const placementActions: {
    describe: ActionDefinition<{
        object: PlacedObject;
    }, PlacementDescription>;
    spaces: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, {
        spaces: PlacementSpaceView[];
    }>;
    related: ActionDefinition<{
        project_id: string;
    }, {
        items: PlacementRelatedItem[];
    }>;
    locate: ActionDefinition<{
        object: PlacedObject;
    }, {
        object: PlacedObject;
        moved: boolean;
    }>;
    link: ActionDefinition<{
        object: PlacedObject;
        project_id: string;
    }, {
        key: string;
    }>;
    unlink: ActionDefinition<{
        key: string;
    }, {
        removed: boolean;
    }>;
    move: ActionDefinition<{
        object: PlacedObject;
        to_project_id: string;
    }, PlacementMoveResponse>;
    copy: ActionDefinition<{
        object: PlacedObject;
        to_project_id: string;
        request_id: string;
    }, PlacementMoveResponse>;
    convert: ActionDefinition<PlacementConvertRequest, PlacementConvertResponse>;
};
